text:
maya: Hi all — quick intro, first day here. I'm blocked on MFA during Okta sign-in. It accepts my password but then the flow says 'SMS not allowed' and won't let me register a passkey. Also I haven't received a 1Password invite and Google shows 'request access' for a few internal docs. Who should I ping for onboarding provisioning?

sam-it: welcome @maya! We disable SMS for prod by default and prefer passkeys or hardware keys. Do you have a FIDO key or can you create a platform passkey on your Mac? If not, we can enable a temporary SMS/TOTP fallback for onboarding and resend the 1Password invite.

maya: I don't have a YubiKey, just my iPhone and a work Mac. Okta only shows "SMS" and "Authenticator app" in the enroll list, no passkey option. How do I add a passkey?

lina: Hey @maya — a couple notes: 1) Passkey (WebAuthn) often appears after device trust completes. Try enrolling device trust first. 2) I'll create a temporary TOTP secret you can add to 1Password so you can finish MFA now. Which authenticator do you prefer (1Password, Google Auth)?

onboard-bot: Ticket created: ONB-5217 — "Maya onboarding: MFA fallbacks + 1Password resend". Assigned to sam-it. ETA 1 hour.

sam-it: Resent 1Password invite to maya@redwood.ai and enabled temporary TOTP + SMS fallback for 24h. You should get an Okta prompt to register an authenticator app. If you still don't see it, clear site data for okta.redwood.ai and retry.

maya: Got the 1Password invite now and installed it. Added the TOTP entry, entered the code, and MFA passed. Still hitting 'request access' on a few internal Drive docs and Confluence pages.

lina: Granting perms now — docs access approved, adding you to eng-docs group for Confluence. Should be immediate but may take a minute to sync.

sam-it: Also toggled your account flag to be passkey-eligible. On mac Safari: Preferences -> Passwords -> Add Passkey (or in Chrome: Settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys). Create one and Okta will surface "Security Key / Passkey" as a factor. We'll migrate you to passkey later this week for full MFA enforcement.

maya: Created a passkey in Safari and re-ran the Okta enroll flow. The passkey option appeared and enrolled successfully. 1Password vaults imported, I can open the team drive docs I needed. Everything looks good on my side :party_parrot: Thanks for the fast help!

lina: Welcome aboard officially! If any other access gaps pop up DM me or ping #new-hires.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll close ONB-5217 after confirming one last folder."
